page_title: WOL 1-2 LEV | Wolfsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Marco Fritz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.

90+4' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Lukas Hradecky anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
90+2' Chance! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) brought his opponent down.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jonas Hofmann.
88' Jeremie Frimpong comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
88' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Josip Stanisic will be replaced by Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' That was close by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
87' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
86' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) for a tough tackle.
85' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
84' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) but poses no threat.
83' The ball spins to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
82' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
81' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Lukas Hradecky makes a great save.
78' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Sebastiaan Bornauw and he is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
78' Substitution. Yannick Gerhardt walks off the pitch and Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
78' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
77' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
76' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the corner into the box, but Pavao Pervan intercepts it and averts the threat.
76' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card.
73' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
73' Marco Fritz blows his whistle as Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattias Svanberg trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
70' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
69' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
69' It seemed like Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
67' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Marco Fritz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' 1 - 2 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
61' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

60' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
60' Substitution. Amine Adli makes way for Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
56' The foul by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Fritz.
56' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Fritz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
52' A wild pass somehow finds Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
49' Victor Boniface received a sweet pass from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), but the advance is stopped.
47' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

47' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
46' Niko Kovac has made a change at the break. Amin Sarr has come on in place of Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
46' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
44' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
41' 1 - 1 Goal! Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
41' Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
40' PENALTY APPEAL by Wolfsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
39' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
37' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card.
36' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
34' An attempted cross from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
34' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
30' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

27' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
27' Marco Fritz interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
24' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a long ball forward to Jeremie Frimpong, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
22' Half-chance! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Pavao Pervan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
20' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
16' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and Marco Fritz immediately signals a free kick.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

15' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Lukas Hradecky is alert and denies him with a nice save.
13' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Victor Boniface plays it into the box, and Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the right post. 0:1.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Marco Fritz blows his whistle after Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolfsburg.

9' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
8' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

8' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Flag goes up against Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Poor challenge! Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Marco Fritz blows his whistle.
1' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Fritz.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
